kind: AI-generated review notes (NOT human decisions; see review/expanded_v1_human_decisions.json)
reviewer: Claude (AI agent, claude-opus-5-5), second-pass review on 2026-11-23
independence_caveat: Performed by the same AI model that wrote the first review notes. It re-read the re-extracted texts rather than the first notes, but it is not an independent reviewer.
method: re-extracted all 30 pairs from the pinned sources and verified the manifest SHA-256 hashes
side-by-side reading for completeness, numbered clauses and sub-clauses, exceptions, qualifiers, legal references
numbers including Arabic numbers written as words (e.g. 54,000 riyals, 180 days, 12 hours, one quarter) compared to English values
article references resolved from Arabic ordinals (e.g. Article 108 -> Articles 98 and 101)

status_criteria.PASS: all clauses, list items, numbers, references and exceptions correspond; differences are translation style only
status_criteria.NEEDS_REVIEW: structure and numbers correspond, but a qualifier, conjunction or term could change legal scope; a human should judge
status_criteria.FAIL: a clause, list item, number, reference or exception is missing, added or contradictory

6.evidence: Same 9 listed areas in the same order; no list item missing or added.

38.evidence: Both prohibitions (employer: profession on permit; worker: before legal change procedures) present.

45.evidence: Conjunction inverted in a definition: AR title 'qualification AND training contract' / body 'qualify OR train'; EN title 'training OR qualification' / body 'train AND qualify'. EN body can be read as requiring both activities, narrowing scope. Token impact: one word.

49.evidence: Same 7 listed areas plus Minister's decisions; none missing.

59.evidence: All four target pay categories (daily, weekly, piecework, hourly), written-consent exception and acquired-rights saving clause present.

Item 2 AR 'unconsumed materials' = EN 'unused materials' (fine).

material_discrepancies.issue: and/or inverted in title and body of a definition; EN body may require both training and qualification
item 1 drops 'employer's' from 'the employer's powers over workers', possibly broadening an exemption from working-hours limits
item 5 'required' vs exams the employer 'wishes to conduct'; item 1 adds 'undue' to the hazard condition
date rule: 'first medical observation' (AR) vs 'first medical diagnosis' (EN) may denote different dates

no_fail_found: No pair has a missing or added clause, list item, number, reference or exception.
